# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Use PascalCase for classes and types, and snake_case for variables, and camelCase for functions.
- Use trailing underscores for private variables in classes.
- Use descriptive names for variables, functions, and classes to enhance code readability.
- Include comments to explain complex logic and important decisions in the code.
- Adhere to the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle to avoid code duplication.
- Keep response formatting clean; avoid stray markdown artifacts, dangling punctuation, and malformed inline code in responses.
- When referencing "Is...", print it as plain text in between "" and do not use it as a placeholder or link.
